# Kemet Spirit

> Explore published excursions on Egypt’s Red Sea coast. Each tour page is the source of truth for its current description, duration, price, inclusions and booking details.

- [Homepage](https://kemetspirit.com/)
- [Excursions](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions)

## Published destinations
- [Hurghada excursions](https://kemetspirit.com/destinations/hurghada): Browse eight currently published excursions in the Hurghada catalogue.

## Published excursions
- [Orange Bay Island & Snorkeling](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/orange-bay-island-snorkeling): Take a boat trip to Giftun Island’s Orange Bay beach with shallow turquoise water, two guided snorkeling stops at coral reefs, and buffet lunch onboard. Duration: Full Day (approx. 7 hours). Starting price: €35.00.
- [Paradise Island Snorkeling Trip](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/paradise-island-snorkeling-trip): Sail to Paradise Beach on Giftun Island with white sand, parasols, folklore dance show, and two coral reef snorkeling stops. Duration: Full Day (approx. 7 hours). Starting price: €32.00.
- [Dolphin House Snorkeling](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/dolphin-house-snorkeling): Take a boat trip to Shaab El Erg reef to see wild dolphins in open water, with two coral snorkeling stops and lunch. Duration: Full Day (approx. 7.5 hours). Starting price: €40.00.
- [Giftun Island Boat Trip](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/giftun-island-boat-trip): The classic Red Sea boat trip featuring sandbar swimming on Giftun Island National Park, relaxing on sun decks, and snorkeling over living coral. Duration: Full Day (approx. 7 hours). Starting price: €30.00.
- [Desert Quad Safari](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/desert-quad-safari): Ride a 250cc ATV quad bike across desert trails and mountain canyons. Includes test drive and Bedouin tea. Duration: Half Day (approx. 3.5 hours). Starting price: €28.00.
- [Desert Safari & Bedouin Experience](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/desert-safari-bedouin-experience): Quad biking, spider dune buggy driving, camel ride, Bedouin village visit, BBQ dinner, and evening folklore show. Duration: Half Day (approx. 5 hours). Starting price: €35.00.
- [Private Red Sea Yacht](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/private-red-sea-yacht): Private yacht charter for up to 8 guests. Choose your stops, snorkel quiet reefs, and enjoy a freshly cooked lunch. Duration: Full Day (approx. 8 hours). Starting price: €250.00.
- [El Gouna Private Boat Trip](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/el-gouna-private-boat-trip): Private cruiser departing Abu Tig Marina. Cruise through El Gouna channels, visit quiet northern reefs, and relax on sandbars. Duration: Full Day (approx. 6 hours). Starting price: €220.00.
- [Introductory Scuba Diving Experience](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/introductory-scuba-diving-experience): No license needed. Try scuba diving with a certified PADI instructor by your side. Includes 2 shallow boat dives and lunch. Duration: Full Day (approx. 8 hours). Starting price: €65.00.
- [Marsa Alam Dolphin House](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/marsa-alam-dolphin-house): Sail to the protected Sha’ab Samadai marine reserve to snorkel near wild dolphins in calm natural lagoons. Duration: Full Day (approx. 8 hours). Starting price: €55.00.
- [Sharm El Naga Beach & Snorkeling Day](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/sharm-el-naga-beach-reef-day): Snorkel straight from a sandy beach without a boat. Includes private bay entry, sun loungers, swimming pool, and lunch. Duration: Full Day (approx. 7 hours). Starting price: €38.00.
- [Sahl Hasheesh Glass Bottom Boat](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/sahl-hasheesh-glass-bottom-boat): View corals and fish through underwater glass windows without getting wet. Sail past sunken pillars with an optional swim stop. Duration: Half Day (approx. 2.5 hours). Starting price: €25.00.
- [Ras Mohammed National Park & White Island Luxury Yacht Cruise](https://kemetspirit.com/excursions/ras-mohammed-white-island-cruise): Cruise through the marine sanctuary of Ras Mohammed National Park, step onto the crystal sandbar of White Island, snorkel coral walls, and enjoy an onboard seafood buffet. Duration: Full Day (approx. 8 hours). Starting price: €45.00.

## Booking information
- Check each excursion page for current availability, pickup details, inclusions, exclusions and cancellation terms.
- Prices, schedules and operational arrangements may change. Confirm the final details on the live booking flow before reserving.
- The privacy information page is not listed here while its full policy is being verified.
